assets.purpose: Decorative garden tabletop cover; game title added by UI
assets.prompt: A bright warm landscape illustration for a family tabletop game cover. A friendly garden picnic table holding a few plain face-down cards with teal leaf patterns, rounded wooden tokens and a little yellow star-shaped charm, surrounded by soft green leaves and cheerful flowers. Scene feels like a sunny garden adventure shared with friends. Painted toy-like forms, subtle cream paper texture, gentle shadows, palette cream white, teal, warm gold and coral. Wide composition, calm background, uncluttered center and comfortable safe margins. No people or creatures. No text, no letters, no numerals, no logos, no watermark, no printed game title, no user interface. Original decorative illustration only.
assets.source: built-in image_gen; original generated decorative illustration
